digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III; Maundu & Tengnäs 2005 gives Mgongolo

teaser.en: Termites can't eat its black heartwood, and one of its Digo names says the baboons got there first.
teaser.sw: Mchwa hawawezi kula kiini chake cheusi, na mojawapo ya majina yake ya Kidigo linasema nyani walifika kwanza.

summary.en: *Mkongolo* is the largest Kenyan *Combretum*, a tall forest tree with peeling bark and very durable black heartwood. Prized for carving, building and tool handles, its big trees have been heavily cut for the carving trade.
summary.sw: *Mkongolo* ndio *Combretum* mkubwa zaidi nchini Kenya, mti mrefu wa msituni wenye gome linalobambuka na kiini cheusi kinachodumu sana. Unathaminiwa kwa uchongaji, ujenzi na mipini ya zana, na miti yake mikubwa imekatwa kwa wingi kwa ajili ya biashara ya vinyago.

about.en:
*Mkongolo* can grow to 20 metres, with a narrow crown and a fluted trunk. Its pale brown bark peels away in large patches, leaving a patchwork surface. Like other combretums, it carries fruits with four papery wings, which spin as they fall.

The treasure is inside: the heartwood is black, very hard and resistant to termites.
about.sw:
*Mkongolo* unaweza kufikia mita 20, ukiwa na kilele chembamba na shina lenye mifereji. Gome lake la kahawia hafifu hubambuka kwa mabaka makubwa, na kuacha uso wa viraka-viraka. Kama *Combretum* nyingine, huzaa matunda yenye mabawa manne membamba kama karatasi, yanayozunguka yanapoanguka.

Hazina iko ndani: kiini cha mti ni cheusi, kigumu sana na kinastahimili mchwa.

where.en: It grows in coastal forest, riverine forest and woodland. Big, mature trees are now uncommon outside protected forest.
where.sw: Hukua katika msitu wa pwani, misitu ya kando ya mito na misitu ya wazi. Miti mikubwa iliyokomaa sasa ni adimu nje ya misitu iliyohifadhiwa.

uses.en:
The black heartwood is very durable and termite-resistant, which makes it valued for carving, building and tool handles. Pakia lists *mkongolo* among the popular Digo timber species. The wood also goes for firewood and charcoal.

The roots are used in traditional medicine for stomach-ache.
uses.sw:
Kiini cheusi cha mti hudumu sana na kinastahimili mchwa, jambo linalokifanya kithaminiwe kwa uchongaji, ujenzi na mipini ya zana. Pakia anaorodhesha *mkongolo* miongoni mwa spishi maarufu za mbao za Wadigo. Mti wake pia hutumika kwa kuni na makaa.

Mizizi hutumika katika dawa za jadi kutibu maumivu ya tumbo.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names: *mkongolo* and *mryanyani*, which means 'eaten by baboons'. The ICRAF handbook writes *mgongolo*. Swahili names include *mgongolo*, *mpera mwitu* and *mgurure*, and the Giriama name is *mugurure*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo: *mkongolo* na *mryanyani*, lenye maana ya 'uliolika na nyani'. Kitabu cha ICRAF kinaandika *mgongolo*. Majina ya Kiswahili ni pamoja na *mgongolo*, *mpera mwitu* na *mgurure*, na jina la Kigiriama ni *mugurure*.

conservation.en: Large trees have been much reduced by the carving trade.
conservation.sw: Miti mikubwa imepungua sana kutokana na biashara ya vinyago.

reason.en: A climbing Combretum that shares its name
River terminalia, in the same family
Another dark carving wood under pressure
reason.sw: Mbao nyingine nyeusi ya kuchongea iliyo chini ya shinikizo

definition.en: The wings on winged fruits. Pakia could not confirm the term because these trees were uncommon in some study areas.
definition.sw: Mabawa ya matunda yenye mabawa. Pakia hakuweza kuthibitisha neno hili kwa sababu miti hii ilikuwa adimu katika baadhi ya maeneo ya utafiti.
